intent: Leave a sunny field, pass into deep woodland, cross its fallen timber and emerge into a bright clearing. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The sunny field
sections.lesson: Find the gap beneath the trees. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.
